title: Where the Model Changes Its Mind: Hindsight-Divergence Localization for Efficient Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2609.36864v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Group-relative methods for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) learn from differences in rollout outcomes. Independently sampling complete trajectories is costly and does not explicitly explore the decision space at critical positions. Feedback on a completed trajectory can reveal which earlier choices the policy reconsiders, suggesting where to sample alternative continuations. We introduce Hindsight-Divergence Localization (HDL), which uses hindsight-induced changes in token log-likelihoods to select branch points. HDL generates a small number of complete root trajectories and fills each training group with continuations from the selected positions under the original task context. Each continuation reuses its root prefix and contributes policy updates only through its newly generated suffix, reducing generation cost while focusing additional exploration and learning on decisions after branching. translated_title: 模型在何处改变主意：面向可验证奖励高效强化学习的后见之明分歧定位方法
translated_abstract: 针对可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的组相对方法从 rollout 结果的差异中学习。独立采样完整轨迹成本高昂，且无法在关键位置显式探索决策空间。对已完成轨迹的反馈可以揭示策略会重新考虑哪些较早的选择，从而提示在哪里采样替代的后续延续。我们提出了后见之明分歧定位，它利用后见之明引起的 token 对数似然变化来选择分支点。HDL 生成少量完整的根轨迹，并在原始任务上下文下用从选定位置出发的延续来填充每个训练组。每个延续复用其根前缀，且仅通过新生成的后缀贡献策略更新，从而降低生成成本，同时将额外的探索和学习聚焦于分支后的决策上。在三个……（摘要在此截断）
tldr: 提出后见之明分歧定位（HDL）方法，通过后见之明引起的 token 对数似然变化定位模型“改变主意”的分支点，并仅从这些位置采样轨迹延续进行 RLVR 训练，以更低的生成成本实现更聚焦的探索与学习。
en_tdlr: Proposes Hindsight-Divergence Localization (HDL), which identifies branch points where the model "changes its mind" via hindsight-induced token log-likelihood shifts and samples continuations only from these positions for RLVR training, achieving more focused exploration and learning at lower generation cost.
